arxiv-1803-04164.title: Sub 20 meV Schottky barriers in metal/MoTe 2 junctions Journal: \TDM
arxiv-1803-04164.creator: Nicola J Townsend, Iddo Amit, Monica F Craciun, Saverio Russo
arxiv-1803-04164.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Nicola J Townsend, Iddo Amit, Monica F Craciun, Saverio Russo. The newly emerging class of atomically-thin materials has shown a high potential for the realisation of novel electronic and optoelectronic components. Amongst this family, semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are of particular interest. While their band gaps are compatible with those of conventional solid state devices, they present a wide range of exciting new properties that is bound to become a crucial ingredient in the future of electronics.

arxiv-2109-02313.title: Design and Synthesis of Clathrate LaB 8 with Superconductivity
arxiv-2109-02313.creator: Liang Ma, Xin Yang, Guangtao Liu, Hanyu Liu, Guochun Yang, Hui Wang, Jinqun Cai, Mi Zhou, Hongbo Wang
arxiv-2109-02313.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Liang Ma, Xin Yang, Guangtao Liu, Hanyu Liu, Guochun Yang, Hui Wang, Jinqun Cai, Mi Zhou, Hongbo Wang. Boron-based clathrate materials, typically with three-dimensional networks of B atoms, have tunable properties through substitution of guest atoms, but the tuning of B cages themselves has not yet been developed. By combining crystal structural search with the laser-heated diamond anvil cell technique, we successfully synthesized a new B-based clathrate boride, LaB 8 , at ∼ \mathrm{\sim} 108 GPa and ∼ \mathrm{\sim} 2100 K.

arxiv-2112-15502.title: Multiple-point residue formulas for holomorphic maps
arxiv-2112-15502.creator: Gergely Bérczi and András Szenes
arxiv-2112-15502.description: Abstract . We develop a new approach to the study of the multipoint loci of holomorphic maps between complex manifolds. We relate the k k -fold locus to the curvilinear component of the Hilbert scheme of k k points on the source space of the map, and using equivariant localisation, we derive a closed iterated multipoint residue formula.

arxiv-2303-16129.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC) is an automated method for generating, manipulating, and modifying valuable and diverse data using AI algorithms creatively. This survey paper focuses on the deployment of AIGC applications, e.g., ChatGPT and Dall-E, at mobile edge networks, namely mobile AIGC networks, that provide personalized and customized AIGC services in real time while maintaining user privacy.

arxiv-2310-14725.title: On Learning Polynomial Recursive Programs CCS: Theory of computation Quantitative automata CCS: Theory of computation Active learning
arxiv-2310-14725.creator: Alex Buna-Marginean, Vincent Cheval, Mahsa Shirmohammadi, James Worrell
arxiv-2310-14725.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alex Buna-Marginean, Vincent Cheval, Mahsa Shirmohammadi, James Worrell. We introduce the class of P-finite automata. These are a generalisation of weighted automata, in which the weights of transitions can depend polynomially on the length of the input word. P-finite automata can also be viewed as simple tail-recursive programs in which the arguments of recursive calls can non-linearly refer to a variable that counts the number of recursive calls.

arxiv-2502-06475.title: Dynamical relevance of periodic orbits under increasing Reynolds number and connections to inviscid dynamics
arxiv-2502-06475.creator: Andrew Cleary 1, Jacob Page 1
arxiv-2502-06475.description: Abstract Large numbers of relative periodic orbits (RPOs) have been found recently in doubly-periodic, two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow at moderate Reynolds numbers \Rey ∈ { 40,100 } \Rey\in\{40,100\} . While these solutions lead to robust statistical reconstructions at the \Rey \Rey -values where they were obtained, it is unclear how their dynamical importance evolves with increasing \Rey \Rey .

arxiv-2503-21424.title: Scaling Automated Database System Testing
arxiv-2503-21424.creator: Suyang Zhong, Manuel Rigger
arxiv-2503-21424.description: Abstract . Recently, various automated testing approaches have been proposed that use specialized test oracles to find hundreds of logic bugs in mature, widely-used Database Management Systems (DBMSs). These test oracles require database and query generators, which must account for the often significant differences between the SQL dialects of these systems.

arxiv-2506-07160.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, particularly in mathematical reasoning, amid which geometry problem solving remains a challenging area where auxiliary construction plays a enssential role. pmc-11715887.title: Event‐based modeling of T‐N mismatch reveals distinct spatio‐temporal trajectories of subtypes with likely co‐pathology in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11715887.creator: Xueying Lyu, Paul A. Yushkevich, Stanislau Hrybouski, Yue Li, Michael Tran Duong, Long Xie, Laura E.M. Wisse, Robin de Flores, David J Irwin, Bradford C. Dickerson, Ilya M. Nasrallah, Sandhitsu R. Das, David A Wolk
pmc-11715887.description: BackgroundThe heterogeneity of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and lack of well‐validated markers of co‐pathologies present a substantial challenge for therapeutics. We previously found phenotypes defined by Tau (T) ‐ Neurodegeneration (N) discordance linked to non‐Alzheimer’s pathologies (e.g. TDP‐43, vascular disease). In this work, we aim to leverage T‐N mismatch for identifying distinct spatial‐temporal progression patterns of non‐AD pathologies.

pmc-12700864.creator: Livia Gerber, Katharina J. Peters, Stephanie L. King, Simon J. Allen, Richard C. Connor, Owen Forbes, Kathryn G. Holmes, Anna M. Kearns, Erik P. Willems, Michael Krützen, Lee A. Rollins
pmc-12700864.description: Ageing is a universal process characterised by the deterioration of functional traits over an individual’s lifespan. Differing degrees of age-related decline between individuals of the same chronological age suggest varying rates of ageing. Identifying factors influencing these inter-individual differences in ‘biological age’ is central to understanding ageing.

pmc-12732490.description: Background/Objectives: The establishment of strong prenatal bonding is a key determinant of perinatal well-being, influencing maternal psychological adaptation and infant development. Numerous studies have examined risk factors and psychopathology during pregnancy, but limited research has explored the role of positive psychological constructs, such as positive mental health (PMH).

pmc-13024570.title: Stratification of Pro-Atherogenic Phenotypes in Prediabetes Using Machine Learning
pmc-13024570.creator: Liana Signorini, Waldemar Volanski, Ademir Luiz do Prado, Glaucio Valdameri, Mauren Isfer Anghebem, Vivian Rotuno Moure, Marcel Henrique Marcondes Sari, Geraldo Picheth, Fabiane Gomes de Moraes Rego
pmc-13024570.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Prediabetes is a metabolic condition involving various phenotypes of glucose metabolism. Prediabetes increases the risk of heart disease, among other conditions. Hence, we employed machine learning tools to characterize phenotypes associated with cardiovascular disease using routine laboratory biomarkers. Methods: We processed laboratory records of over 1,000,000 de-identified individuals, resulting in a sample of 3024 individuals classified as prediabetic (fasting blood glucose 100–125 mg/dL combined with HbA1c 5.7–6.4%).

pmc-13233529.description: Caseous mitral annular calcification (CMAC) is a rare morphological variant of mitral annular calcification. pmc-13391580.title: Holocord syringomyelia associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease: a case series
pmc-13391580.creator: Shijie Li, He Wang, Tao Liu, Xiangdong Yin, Shengli Shen, Liang Li, Hongzhou Duan
pmc-13391580.description: IntroductionHolocord syringomyelia is a rare and severe form of syringomyelia, often associated with disruptions in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics. In patients with von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) disease, multifocal spinal hemangioblastomas may contribute to the development of extensive syringomyelia. However, the pathogenesis and optimal management of VHL-associated holocord syringomyelia remain poorly defined.

pmc-13614975.title: Online Information as a Double-Edged Sword: A Multilevel Analysis of Vaccination Skepticism Based on ISSP 2021
pmc-13614975.creator: Alexander Helbing, Juliane Heise, Sophie Redlin, Peter Kriwy
pmc-13614975.description: This study examines the relationship between internet use and vaccine scepticism, focusing on the ambivalent role of digital information environments and digital health literacy (DHL). While the internet provides easy access to vaccination-related information, frequent internet use may also increase exposure to misinformation and disinformation. Accordingly, both positive and negative effects of internet-based information seeking are hypothesized.
